AC_Arena.Header_Text:
{~r}Welcome to the Arena of Life and Death{~}
											Remember, you are only allowed one arena combat per visit. To fight an arena battle, select the option that best describes your abilities and return to me if you survive...
AC_Arena.Rules_Text:
{~Yellow}Rules of the Arena of Life and Death{~}

{~LimeGreen}Standard Arenas 1-15{~} - @standard_difficulty@
- Enemy numbers and configured growth depend on the difficulty.
- Each Arena has individual level limits, combat rules and rewards.

{~Red}Boss Arenas 16-30{~} - @boss_difficulty@
- Boss stats, damage and scripted effects depend on the difficulty.
- Boss Arenas require the Advanced Classes Mod.

{~Yellow}General Rules{~}
- Your army, Commander and Henchman are restored after every battle.
- Entry costs 200 movement points plus the configured gold fee; visit restrictions apply.
- Right-click an Arena for details or a Boss in combat to inspect its stats.
